title: 16-Year-Old Teen Steals And Runs Off With Guys iPhone Then Tries To Deny It
description:
#news #police #arrest

On January 11th, 2022. Officers received a call from a man stating he just witnessed a 16-year-old teenager steal and run off with another teenager's iPhone. The teen stated that the suspect asked to use his phone to call his mom but seconds later, he immediately ran. When officers finally caught up with the suspect, he was less than truthful about the situation. The suspect was identified as Jahmiah.
